rule.title: Deterministic Word Window Chunking with Overlap
rule.statement: Document text must be chunked into deterministic word windows (500 words) with a mandatory boundary overlap (50 words).
rule.rationale: Without overlap, critical contextual sentences split across chunk boundaries are lost during embedding, destroying retrieval accuracy.
rule.implementation_guidance: Implement sliding window chunking. Preserve sheet prefixes for Excel rows and page metadata for PDFs.

forbidden.example: Splitting text by raw character length without overlap, cutting words and sentences in half.

source.evidence_quote: Boundary overlap ensures that contextual information spanning chunk boundaries is preserved. A 10% overlap is standard for general prose.
